forClinics.title: One schedule the whole clinic can trust.
forClinics.intro: Run appointments, reception, queue, reminders, and patient communication from one source of truth.
forClinics.proofOne: The same availability for reception and patients
forClinics.proofThree: Pulse works from clinic-approved hours and rules
forClinics.scheduleText: A booking is confirmed only after the scheduling service records it, so the public page and front desk do not drift apart.
forClinics.queueTitle: A queue the staff can act on
forClinics.queueText: Reception sees arrivals, delays, and the next action without keeping a second list on paper or WhatsApp.
forClinics.pulseText: It can answer, find, hold, reschedule, or cancel — and asks for confirmation before a consequential action.

about.title: Certainty between the patient and the clinic.
about.intro: Nabda connects discovery to the same schedule the clinic team uses, so the next step is clear before a patient travels or calls.
about.oneBody: Arabic-first patient journeys, familiar payment choices, Cairo time, and clinic operations designed around the real front desk.
about.twoBody: Directory results are ordered by availability, rating, and distance — never by paid placement.
about.threeBody: Pulse can help with access and administration. Clinical decisions remain with qualified clinicians.

help.title: A clear answer before the next step.
help.intro: Find out how booking, changes, payment, and clinic confirmation work.
help.oneBody: It is live availability. The appointment becomes confirmed only after the clinic schedule commits your booking.
help.twoBody: Most appointments are paid at the clinic. If a clinic supports online payment, that option appears clearly before confirmation.
help.threeBody: Yes. Pulse can show alternatives and make the change after you confirm the exact appointment.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms explain how the Nabda directory, clinic pages, booking service, and Pulse assistant may be used.
terms.oneBody: A selected or held time is not an appointment until the clinic scheduling service confirms it.
terms.twoBody: Nabda and Pulse do not replace a clinician, diagnosis, prescription, or emergency service.
terms.threeBody: Users must provide accurate booking details and may not misuse access, identity, clinic, or patient information.

privacy.title: Your information has a defined purpose.
privacy.intro: Nabda processes the minimum information needed to find care, manage appointments, and support authorised clinic work.
privacy.oneBody: Contact details, booking information, consent records, and service activity are used only for stated care-access and operational purposes.
privacy.twoBody: Access follows role and clinic permissions. Sensitive actions are logged and attributable.
privacy.threeBody: Requests to access, correct, or delete eligible information are handled according to applicable policy and law.

tokens.title: Tokens, type, and motion
tokens.intro: A live reference for the decisions that keep Nabda calm, legible, and dependable in both scripts.
tokens.paletteIntro: Brand constants stay fixed. Semantic tokens below adapt to the selected theme.
tokens.semanticIntro: Components consume these role-based tokens instead of palette constants.
tokens.statusesIntro: Colour is always reinforced by an icon and an explicit label.
